name: netboxUrl
label: NetBox URL
help: The address used to open NetBox in a browser. For NetBox Cloud this is `https://<name>.cloud.netboxapp.com`.

pattern.message: Enter the full address of the NetBox instance, e.g. https://netbox.example.com

fields.name: v2Token
fields.label: Token
fields.help: Paste the value exactly as NetBox shows it, with or without the leading `Bearer`.

fields.name: v2Key
fields.label: Key
fields.help: Only needed if **Token** contains just the secret, without the `nbt_<key>.` prefix.

fields.name: v1Deprecation
fields.content: ⚠️ v1 API tokens are deprecated and will be removed in a future NetBox release. Please use v2 tokens instead.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to a self-managed NetBox instance that uses a self-signed or private CA certificate.
